title: Founder Operator Library

title: Memphis Vendor Library
mission: A local-first consumer publication covering Memphis vendors, weddings, parties, celebrations, hosting, event logistics, and broadly useful planning guidance where geography does not materially change the answer.
definition: Memphis Vendor Library is a local consumer publication for people planning weddings, parties, porch styling and grazing tables in the Memphis area. It sets out the questions, cost drivers and checklists to use before booking a vendor.
home_descriptor: what to ask before booking a vendor
disclosure: Memphis Vendor Library is part of an affiliated consumer-resource network. Some articles reference affiliated planning tools when directly relevant. Resources are included for contextual usefulness and are not paid rankings or independent awards.

title: Professional Resource Library
mission: A carefully separated professional resource publication for regulated-service research, equine legal education, and workplace mental-health resources.
definition: Professional Resource Library is an educational publication that keeps regulated-service topics separate: legal, medical, immigration, dental, equine legal and workplace mental-health research. It explains what to ask and compare before choosing a provider, and it does not give professional advice.
home_descriptor: what to ask a regulated provider
disclosure: This publication separates legal, medical, mental health, immigration, and regulated-service topics. It is educational only and does not provide professional advice.
